notes.40: NEW in v3.2: Discharge C-rate of the relevant cycle-life test, optional for all three categories.
notes.47: Merged from v2.0 DP 46 (component part numbers) + DP 47 (contact details of sources for replacement spares). Both are now a single mandatory data point.
notes.51: EV/LMT cell 'same as data point 11 (capacity), but now dynamic' normalised to mandatory (DP 11 is mandatory; required to hit the 46/49 totals)
notes.accessTiers: v3.2 adds explicit access-tier column: Public (DP 1–45) vs Restricted (DP 46–71). Stored as accessTier: 'public'|'restricted'.
notes.raw: Cell text de-wrapped from PDF column extraction (line breaks joined with single spaces).
